text_blocks.snippet: Endometrioid ovarian cancer is a type of epithelial ovarian cancer, accounting for about 10-13% of all ovarian cancers. It is characterized by its association with endometriosis and often presents at an earlier stage compared to other ovarian cancer types, with a potentially better prognosis.
